units.source_text: 到了十一月里，薰中纳言闻得大女公子病已稍愈，加之公私事绪纷忙，以致五六天不曾遣使存问。

en.t: When the eleventh month came, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard that the elder princess's illness had somewhat improved, but public and private affairs kept him so busy that for five or six days he sent no messenger to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 忽然想起，不知以后病状如何，便抛开繁忙的要事，匆匆入山探望。

en.t: Suddenly remembering her, and wondering how her condition had been since then, he set aside his urgent business and hurried into the mountains to visit her.

units.source_text: 他曾叮嘱祈祷须举行至病愈为止。

en.t: He had previously instructed them to continue the prayers until she recovered.

units.source_text: 今因病势稍愈，已请阿阇梨返山，故此时山庄中人数很少，照例由那个老侍女弁君出来，向薰中纳言报告病状。

en.t: Now, because her illness had eased a little, they had asked the Ajari to return to his mountain temple, so there were very few people at the villa, and as usual the old gentlewoman Ben no Kimi came out to report her condition to Kaoru.

units.source_text: 她说：“说不出何种痛苦，并不是重大病症，只是饮食全然不进。

en.t: She said, "It is hard to say what sort of suffering it is, and it is not a grave illness in itself, but she cannot take any food at all.

units.source_text: 大小姐本来身体柔弱，异乎常人。

en.t: The elder lady has always been unusually delicate and frail.

units.source_text: 自从家里出了匂亲王那件事情之后，她的心情更加郁结，连果物也不吃一点了。

en.t: Ever since that affair with Prince Niou happened in the household, her spirits have grown even more oppressed, and she will not eat even a little fruit.

units.source_text: 都因如此日积月累，弄得身体异常衰弱，看来已经全无希望了。

en.t: Because this has gone on day after day and month after month, her body has become terribly weak, and now there seems to be no hope at all.

units.source_text: 我们这种命苦的人，反而长生在世，眼看这种逆事。

en.t: Unfortunate people like us go on living, only to witness such heartbreaking calamities.

units.source_text: 我毫无办法，恨不得早一步先死了。”

en.t: There is nothing I can do, and I wish I could have died before her."

units.source_text: 没有说完，已经泣不成声。

en.t: Before she had finished speaking, she was already sobbing too hard to form words.

units.source_text: 这原是怪不得的。

en.t: It was only natural that she should be so overcome.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“为什么不早把这情况告诉我呢？

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "Why did you not tell me of this sooner?

units.source_text: 近来冷泉院及宫中，事情都很繁忙，我好几天不曾前来探望，心中挂念得很！”

en.t: Lately matters at Reizei-in and at court have both been very demanding, and though I have not been able to come for several days, I have been deeply worried!"

units.source_text: 他就被引导到以前到过的房间里，坐在大女公子枕畔，对她谈话。

en.t: He was then shown into the room he had visited before, sat down by the elder princess's pillow, and spoke to her.

units.source_text: 然而大女公子似乎已经不能做声，一句也不回答。

en.t: But the elder princess seemed no longer able to speak, and she did not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言恨恨地说：“小姐病势如此沉重，谁也不来向我通报，实在太疏忽了。

en.t: Kaoru said bitterly, "For the young lady's illness to be this serious, and for no one to come and inform me, is truly careless.

units.source_text: 我无论何等挂念，也是枉费心机。”

en.t: However much I worry, it is all in vain."

units.source_text: 便招请那个阿阇梨及世间以灵验著名的许多僧人，于明日开始举行修法祈祷及诵经。

en.t: He then summoned that Ajari and many monks renowned in the world for the efficacy of their rites, arranging for prayers, ritual services, and sutra recitations to begin the next day.

units.source_text: 又召集他的许多侍臣前来照料。

en.t: He also called together many of his attendants to come and help care for her.

units.source_text: 上下人等喧哗扰攘，非常热闹。

en.t: People high and low bustled about noisily, and the place became very lively.

units.source_text: 众侍女全然忘记了过去的忧愁，都觉得有希望了。

en.t: The waiting women completely forgot their earlier grief and all felt that there was hope now.
